entities.name: Kwain
entities.description: A rabbitfolk wizard from Bloomburrow, fast-moving and fast-talking.

events.summary: Kwain runs circles around Archelos trying to get a reaction.
events.quote: he finds himself drawn to the turtle, literally running circles around him trying to get any sort of reaction.

relations.quote: no one frustrates him more than the turtlefolk Archelos .
